evals.prompt: I need curl commands for Directus REST API — how do I list, create, and update items?
evals.expected_output: Curl examples for GET/POST/PATCH /items/{collection} with auth
expectations: Shows query parameters (fields, filter, sort, limit)

evals.prompt: How do I do schema migrations between Directus environments?
evals.expected_output: 3-step pipeline: snapshot, diff, apply with curl examples
expectations: Includes curl command examples with auth headers

evals.prompt: Show me REST calls to create a Content Editor role that can read and update posts in Directus 12
evals.expected_output: policy first, permissions on the policy, role, access row attaching the policy
expectations: Creates a policy with POST /policies (admin_access and app_access live on the policy)
Creates permissions with POST /permissions using policy, not role
Creates the role with POST /roles without admin_access or app_access
Attaches the policy to the role with POST /access
